name: Koi no Otogizoushi wa Butai Kara
original_name: 恋の御伽草子は舞台から
source:
This story focuses on the celebrity school Saionji Academy, which is renowned as a famous Japanese traditional arts school. Saionji Academy is a school where the sons of families’ famed for their backgrounds in: the Way of the Tea Ceremony, Flower Arrangement, and Noh Plays gather. You end up entering that celebrity academy's general course as a teacher or a student*.
(*In this game, you can enjoy the story from either the perspective of a student or a teacher!)

You are only a normal person in a completely different world for celebrities.
Even in a world of celebrities, there are some who stand out above all the rest.
They are:

The Genius of The Way of Tea, the narcissist, Shiryu Saionji.
The Prince of the Flower Arrangement World, the gentleman, Akihito Nanjo.
The God of Noh, the passionate and enthusiastic Ren Tojo.
You will see the story unfold once you choose one of these three appealing men.
What will be the fate of your love story!?
translation:
故事聚焦于西园寺学院，这所名门学校因传承日本传统艺术而闻名。来自茶道、花道与能乐名门的子弟都会聚集于此。你将以教师或学生*的身份进入这所名流学院的普通科。
（*在本作中，你可以从学生或教师的视角体验故事！）

在名流云集的异世界里，你只是一个普通人。即使在名流之中，也有人格外出众：

茶道界的天才、自恋的西园寺紫龙；
花道界的王子、绅士南条明仁；
能乐之神、热情洋溢的东条莲。

选择三名迷人的男性之一后，故事将展开。你的恋爱故事会迎来怎样的命运？！
